entities.name: Charles Antoine de La Roche-Aymon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charles Antoine, Count of La Roche-Aymon, born at Mainsat (Marche) on 17 February 1697 and died in Paris on 27 October 1777, was a French prelate, cardinal and Grand Almoner of France.
